Shrek's house is 1/3 of Shrek's yard wide. If his backyard is 80 feet wide, find Shrek's house width and its area. Round the answer to the nearest whole number.
 ________________________________________________________________________________________________

 ____________________________________________________________________________________________________________
 ____________________________________________________________________________________________________________
 ____________________________________________________________________________________________________________ Shrek's house is 80 feet wide.

Shrek's house has an area of 752.56 square feet. 

Here's how to calculate it:

Area of Shrek's house = (Width of Shrek's house) x (Width of Shrek's yard)
Area of Shrek's house = 80 x 1/3 x 80
Area of Shrek's house = 2133.333... square feet

Rounded to the nearest whole number, Shrek's house has an area of 752 square feet.
